com.xilinx.rapidwright.design.tools

Class RegisterInitTools

  • Object
    • com.xilinx.rapidwright.design.tools.RegisterInitTools

  • public class RegisterInitTools
extends Object
    Utility methods for updating flip-flop initial values after place and route. This is useful to change the INIT value of registers without re-running implementation.

    • Method Detail

      • setRegisterValue

        public static int setRegisterValue(Design design,
                                   String registerBaseName,
                                   long value,
                                   int width)
        Updates the INIT values of a multi-bit register given a long value. Assumes register bits are named with bus notation, e.g., "my_reg_reg[0]", "my_reg_reg[1]", etc.
        Parameters:
        design - The design containing the register
        registerBaseName - The base name of the register without bus index (e.g., "my_reg_reg")
        value - The new value to set
        width - The width of the register in bits
        Returns:
        The number of flip-flops updated
